preserved_metadata_exception: CC0-1.0 for the SPDX documents that declare it
rules: The map allocates terms to the corresponding author-controlled component or portion. Third-party material retains its own terms.
Existing MIT grants and their copyright/permission notices remain effective, including associated documentation already covered by MIT.
Code does not become CC BY merely because it appears inside a record, log or document. Author-controlled code is MIT; third-party code retains its original terms.
SPDX dataLicense applies to the SPDX metadata only. It does not license the described packages or research collection.
No exclusive copyright is asserted in bare facts. CC BY applies to author-controlled copyright and similar rights, including any applicable collection/database rights.
Current byte identities are recorded in DISTRIBUTION_MANIFEST.json. This allocation map deliberately does not duplicate those hashes.
